restaurant_name: เด็นต้าแคร์ปากน้ำ
text:
I came here for dental treatment under the government's universal healthcare scheme. It's truly free! The dentists don't charge extra. They're kind and offer free check-ups and treatment. You just need to bring your original ID card. The clinic staff are very polite. At first, I thought that because it's free, it would be like a regular hospital, but the service here is excellent. I'm very impressed. I've used my benefits three times here. For the remaining treatments, the dentist recommended going to a hospital, meaning it's up to me whether I want to continue here (but have to wait for the next fiscal year) or go to a hospital.
My son also had orthodontic treatment here. Dr. Pui is very kind and speaks very well. She took care of my son's orthodontic treatment, transforming his crooked teeth into beautiful teeth. After more than two years, even after removing the braces, his teeth are still beautiful. We've been using their services for 10 years, with our whole family coming here. The dentists are kind, the prices are fair and not expensive, and the dentists provide excellent care. Since the clinic accepts the government's universal healthcare scheme for free dental treatment, it's truly free. I'm very impressed and will continue to use their services.
